tagDisplayName: LLM Context — Web search API for AI agents
tagDescription: Pre-extracted web content optimized for AI agents, LLM grounding, and RAG pipelines. Use this API to get the context for your LLM or AI agent.

id.title: Id
id.description: A unique identifier for this particular occurrence of the problem.

status.title: Status
status.description: The HTTP status code applicable to this problem, expressed as a string value.

detail.title: Detail
detail.description: Explanation specific to this occurrence of the problem. Like title, this field’s value can be localized.

meta.title: Meta
meta.description: A meta object containing non-standard meta-information about the error.

code.description: An application-specific error code, expressed as a string value.

generic.title: Generic
generic.description: Array of LLM context items with extracted web content.

poi.description: Point of interest data. When enable_local is enabled, the response may include POI data.

map.title: Map
map.description: Map/place results. When enable_local is enabled, the response may include map data.

LLMContext.title: LLMContext
LLMContext.description: Container for all LLM context content by type.

sources.title: Sources
sources.description: Metadata for all referenced URLs, keyed by URL.

LLMContextAPIResponse.title: LLMContextAPIResponse
LLMContextAPIResponse.description: Response model for the LLM Context API (/v1/llm/context).

snippets.title: Snippets
snippets.description: Extracted text chunks from the page that are picked for their relevance to the query.

LLMContextItem.title: LLMContextItem
LLMContextItem.description: A single LLM context item with URL, title, snippets, and optional last modified dates.

LLMContextMapItem.title: LLMContextMapItem
LLMContextMapItem.description: A map/place item returned in the map array for local recall queries.

name.title: Name
name.description: The name of the point of interest.

url.title: Url
url.description: The URL of the point of interest.

title.title: Title
title.description: The title of the point of interest.

snippets.title: Snippets
snippets.description: The snippets about the point of interest.

LLMContextPOIItem.title: LLMContextPOIItem
LLMContextPOIItem.description: A point of interest item returned in the poi array for local recall queries.

q.title: Q
q.description: The user’s search query term. Query can not be empty. Maximum of 600 characters and 75 words in the query.

country.description: The search query country, where the results come from. The country string is limited to 2 character country codes of supported countries.

search_lang.description: The search language preference. The 2 or more character language code for which the search results are provided.

count.title: Count
count.description: The maximum number of search results considered to select the LLM context data. The default is 20 and the maximum is 50.

safesearch.title: Safe search
safesearch.description:
Filters results for adult content. The following values are supported:

  • off - No filtering is done.
  • moderate - Drops adult content from the results used for context.
  • strict - Drops all adult content from the results used for context.

When not set, no filtering is applied — except for local recall, which stays strict.

spellcheck.title: Spellcheck
spellcheck.description: Whether to enable spellcheck on the query.

maximum_number_of_urls.title: Maximum Number Of Urls
maximum_number_of_urls.description: Maximum number of different URLs to include in LLM context.

maximum_number_of_tokens.title: Maximum Number Of Tokens
maximum_number_of_tokens.description: Approximate maximum number of tokens to include in context. The default is 8192 and maximum is 32768.

maximum_number_of_snippets.title: Maximum Number Of Snippets
maximum_number_of_snippets.description: Maximum number of different snippets (or chunks of text) to include in LLM context. The default is 50 and maximum is 256.

context_threshold_mode.description: The mode to use to determine the threshold for including content in context.

maximum_number_of_tokens_per_url.title: Maximum Number Of Tokens Per Url
maximum_number_of_tokens_per_url.description: Maximum number of tokens to include per URL. The default is 4096 and maximum is 8192.

maximum_number_of_snippets_per_url.title: Maximum Number Of Snippets Per Url
maximum_number_of_snippets_per_url.description: Maximum number of snippets to include per URL. The default is 50 and maximum is 100.

goggles.title: Goggles
goggles.description: Goggles act as a custom re-ranking on top of Brave’s search index. The parameter supports both a url where the Goggle is hosted or the definition of the Goggle. For more details, see the Goggles documentation. The parameter can be a single Goggle or a list of up to 3 Goggles.

freshness.title: Freshness
freshness.description:
Filters search results by page age. The age of a page is determined by the most relevant date reported by the content, such as its published or last modified date. The following values are supported:

  • pd - Pages aged 24 hours or less.
  • pw - Pages aged 7 days or less.
  • pm - Pages aged 31 days or less.
  • py - Pages aged 365 days or less.
  • YYYY-MM-DDtoYYYY-MM-DD - A custom date range is also supported by specifying start and end dates e.g. 2022-04-01to2022-07-30.

enable_local.title: Enable Local
enable_local.description: Whether to enable local recall. Not setting this value means auto-detect: local recall is used if a location is provided (X-Loc-Lat with X-Loc-Long, or X-Loc-City).

enable_source_metadata.title: Enable Source Metadata
enable_source_metadata.description: Enable source metadata enrichment (site_name, favicon, thumbnail, description, fetched_content_timestamp) in the sources attribute of the response.

age.title: Age
age.description: The page’s date rendered four ways, in fixed positions: full date, YYYY-MM-DD, relative age, and an ISO 8601 timestamp. Empty when the page has no known date.

favicon.title: Favicon
favicon.description: URL to the site’s favicon image.

thumbnail.description: Page thumbnail: src is the proxied URL (ready to serve); original is the raw upstream URL.

robotstxt_status.title: Robotstxt Status
robotstxt_status.description: Robots.txt status for the requested user-agent: allow, disallow, or unknown.

snippet.title: Snippet
snippet.description: The most query-relevant passage of the source page.

description.title: Description
description.description: The page’s own description, independent of the query (unlike snippet). Requires enable_source_metadata.

fetched_content_timestamp.title: Fetched Content Timestamp
fetched_content_timestamp.description: Unix seconds of the index’s last fetch of this page. Requires enable_source_metadata.

Source.title: Source
Source.description: Minimal metadata for a referenced source URL.

src.title: Src
src.description: The served URL of the picture thumbnail.

alt.title: Alt
alt.description: The alt text for the thumbnail image.

bg_color.title: Bg Color
bg_color.description: The background color of the thumbnail.

original.title: Original
original.description: The original URL of the image.

logo.title: Logo
logo.description: Whether the thumbnail is a logo.

duplicated.title: Duplicated
duplicated.description: Whether the thumbnail is a duplicate.

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: The theme of the thumbnail (e.g., light or dark).

snakepit__models__search_api__specs__ato.title: Thumbnail
snakepit__models__search_api__specs__ato.description: Aggregated details representing a picture thumbnail.
